svg.aria-label: 01 Campus, my core project: a site and an app for one study group that lives on the group leader's own computer. 189 Java classes, 163 UI components, 103 test files, 35 migrations, 30 versions, v1.0.1 release.
svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: 01 Campus, my core project: a site and an app for one study group that lives on the group leader's own computer. 189 Java classes, 163 UI components, 103 test files, 35 migrations, 30 versions, v1.0.1 release.
svg.desc: A dark terminal page: the architecture drawn in box characters with sync packets running from the host to each device, and git log --graph of the latest Campus commits typing itself out.

g.text: A site and an app for one study group:
homework, a schedule from an .ics file, news
and files. It lives on the group leader's own
computer, and every phone keeps a copy that
syncs when the host is back on.
